title: Leo Tashev and Fraser Lloyd, Student Property Network: interview at Night Summit (PrompTugal.news, 10 November 2026)
what_it_says: PrompTugal's own page for a three-minute interview recorded on 9 November 2026 at Night Summit, Web Summit's opening night; it summarises what the founders said, with their agreement, and notes which figures PrompTugal has not checked.
